summary:

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.cnn.com/media/sites/cnn/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 11502 bytes. Directory sizes: 48×48, 32×32, 16×16.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://www.cnn.com/media/sites/cnn/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 76×76 png.

Brand colour #cc0000 comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-76x76-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.
